# Enrichment

This document merges the enrichment script of the Enrichment folder. The prioritized
blood and brain genes are submitted to gene ontology (GO) over-representation analysis
and the enriched terms are displayed as bubble plots faceted by GO category.

The GO result tables are read from the Excel files that the enrichment analysis
produced, and the terms that are highlighted in the manuscript are printed in bold.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `SA_ProGene_enrichment_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "SA_ProGene_enrichment_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SA_ProGene_enrichment_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)
library(DOSE)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(ggtext)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Blood GO and KEGG enrichment analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
#Set the working directory
setwd("Path/Enrichment/")

bold_terms <- c("regulation of macroautophagy","regulation of vacuole organization","organic hydroxy compound catabolic process","neuron cellular homeostasis","macroautophagy","regulation of autophagy","ATPase binding","oxidoreductase activity, acting on CH-OH group of donors")   
# replace with the actual pathway names

#bubble plot
GO_enrich_df<-read_excel("GO_SA_Blood.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
GO_enrich_df$type_order <- factor(GO_enrich_df$Description,
                                  levels = rev(sort(unique(GO_enrich_df$Description))))

#jpeg(file = "SA_Blood_bubble.jpg",width=40,height=35,units="cm",res = 600)
jpeg(file = "SA_Blood_bubble.jpg",width=36,height=35,units="cm",res = 600)
# set the factor level order of Category (in the order in which they appear in the data)
GO_enrich_df$Category <- factor(GO_enrich_df$Category, levels = c("BP", "MF"))
plot2<-ggplot(data = GO_enrich_df,aes(x=Count,y=type_order))+
  geom_point(aes(size=Count,color=p.adjust))+
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(6, 9),  # adjust here: the first value is the smallest bubble size, the second value is the largest bubble size
    name = "Count",  # legend title
    breaks = c(1,2,3)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#FD8D62",high = "darkblue",
                       breaks = c(0.02, 0.03, 0.04),  # specify the tick values
                       guide = guide_colorbar(reverse = TRUE)  # reverse the order in which the legend is displayed
                       )+
  #geom_text(aes(label=geneID),hjust=1.2,size=4.5)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.8, 3.2),breaks = c(1,2,3))+
  # add a discrete y-axis scale that prints the selected pathway names in bold
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) ifelse(x %in% bold_terms, paste0("<b>", x, "</b>"), x)) +
  labs(color=expression(p.adjust,size="Count"),
       x="Gene Number",y="",title = "")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",size = 17),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",size = 17),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 18),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),  # facet title
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),     # facet title background
        # remove the background grid lines
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        # use element_markdown so that the y-axis labels support HTML bold text
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(color = "black", size = 17)) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
print(plot2)
dev.off()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Brain GO and KEGG enrichment analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
#Set the working directory
setwd("Path/Enrichment/")

bold_terms <- c("negative regulation of macroautophagy","regulation of vacuole organization","activation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity involved in apoptotic process","negative regulation of autophagy","protein targeting to mitochondrion","apoptotic mitochondrial changes","positive regulation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity involved in apoptotic process","establishment of protein localization to mitochondrion","protein localization to mitochondrion","positive regulation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity","lysosomal transport","epithelial cell apoptotic process","positive regulation of endopeptidase activity","regulation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity involved in apoptotic process","positive regulation of peptidase activity","vacuolar transport","regulation of macroautophagy","mitochondrial transport","regulation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity","negative regulation of cellular catabolic process","vacuole organization","late endosome membrane","late endosome")   
# replace with the actual pathway names

#bubble plot
GO_enrich_df<-read_excel("GO_SA_Brain.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
GO_enrich_df$type_order <- factor(GO_enrich_df$Description,
                                  levels = rev(sort(unique(GO_enrich_df$Description))))

#jpeg(file = "SA_Brain_bubble.jpg",width=38,height=28,units="cm",res = 600)
jpeg(file = "SA_Brain_bubble.jpg",width=43,height=28,units="cm",res = 600)
# set the factor level order of Category (in the order in which they appear in the data)
GO_enrich_df$Category <- factor(GO_enrich_df$Category, levels = c("BP", "CC"))
plot2<-ggplot(data = GO_enrich_df,aes(x=Count,y=type_order))+
  geom_point(aes(size=Count,color=p.adjust))+
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(7, 9),  # adjust here: the first value is the smallest bubble size, the second value is the largest bubble size
    name = "Count",  # legend title
    breaks = c(1,2,3)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#FD8D62",high = "darkblue",
                       breaks = c(0.02, 0.03, 0.04),  # specify the tick values
                       guide = guide_colorbar(reverse = TRUE)  # reverse the order in which the legend is displayed
                       )+
  #geom_text(aes(label=geneID),hjust=1.2,size=4.5)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.8, 3.2),breaks = c(1,2,3))+
  # add a discrete y-axis scale that prints the selected pathway names in bold
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) ifelse(x %in% bold_terms, paste0("<b>", x, "</b>"), x)) +
  labs(color=expression(p.adjust,size="Count"),
       x="Gene Number",y="",title = "")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",size = 18),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",size = 19),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),  # facet title
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),     # facet title background
        # remove the background grid lines
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        # use element_markdown so that the y-axis labels support HTML bold text
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(color = "black", size = 18)) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
print(plot2)
dev.off()
```
